definitions.explanation: In a state of good health, proper functioning, or moral soundness. Used for physical health, mental well-being, organizations, finances, and moral character.

examples.japanese: {健全|けんぜん}な{精神|せいしん}は{健全|けんぜん}な{肉体|にくたい}に{宿|やど}る。
examples.english: A sound mind dwells in a sound body.

examples.japanese: {財政|ざいせい}を{健全|けんぜん}に{保|たも}つことが{重要|じゅうよう}だ。
examples.english: It is important to keep finances sound.

examples.japanese: {青少年|せいしょうねん}の{健全|けんぜん}な{育成|いくせい}のために{地域|ちいき}で{取|と}り{組|く}んでいる。
examples.english: The community is working to promote the wholesome development of young people.

notes:
A versatile word used across many contexts — physical health, mental health, organizational management, financial stability, and moral education. The phrase {健全|けんぜん}な{育成|いくせい} (wholesome upbringing) is common in educational and government discourse.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{健全|けんぜん}な{経営|けいえい} (sound management)
・{健全|けんぜん}な{財政|ざいせい} (sound finances)
・{健全|けんぜん}な{発展|はってん} (healthy development)
・{健全|けんぜん}な{精神|せいしん} (sound mind)
